India Faces Water Shortages, Extreme Weather Amid Monsoon

Several parts of India are experiencing water scarcity and agricultural distress due to poor rainfall and high temperatures. In Karnataka, poor rains and heat have impacted vegetable farming and led to low water storage in reservoirs, potentially sparking an agrarian crisis. Similarly, Odisha's Koraput district has seen slow paddy coverage due to poor showers, and Tamil Nadu's Karimangalam faces a water crisis affecting groundnut cultivation. Adilabad farmers are anxious over kharif crops due to a rain deficit. Meanwhile, Himachal Pradesh is on red alert for floods and landslides due to extremely heavy rain, and monsoon activity is expected to increase in North India.
